findings.title: Give the in-place scalar-pair update a value distinct from setup
findings.observed: All 180 complete count_inline_scalar_pair action stages end in 7 8.5. Both discovery and reserved seeds also use 7 8.5. embedded_pair_eof supplies integer7 after a setup that already stored integer7.
findings.native_contract: 0x14041bed0 scans int to record+0x70 then double to+0x68 directly, without zeroing; a one-conversion pair is success and retains the old double. Its following table-header EOF causes the eventual handler2.
findings.impact: A candidate that consumes the new integer but omits its store on reused records can produce the same observed pair, handler status, and cursor in the partial-pair fixture. Successful reused records likewise cannot establish that both scalar fields were replaced. Other inline/table markers do not distinguish this omission.
findings.requested_revision: Parameterize scalar and real values through selector2/record, using distinct bounded values for seed and action. At minimum make embedded_pair_eof integer differ from its seeded integer and explicitly assert the new integer plus old double. Give a successful reused-record action two new scalar values; preserve cohort separation when adding reserved variants.
findings.proposed_check: For a concrete discovery example, seed pair7/8.5 then partial pair19 followed by EOF: record+0x70=19, record+0x68=8.5, pair scan result1, following nested-header EOF, handler2, no list clear and no refresh0. A successful later pair23/24.5 should replace both. Values are proposals, not captured native output.

findings.title: Restrict the twelve-value clamp assertion to the count13 case
findings.observed: The loop attaches the same expected assertion to all five cases: Declared13 emits clamp diagnostic and consumes12 values; this fixture supplies only12 inline values. Actual inline payload counts are respectively0,0,1,12,12.
findings.native_contract: 0x14029ccd0 emits its diagnostic and overwrites the count with12 only when the signed input count is greater than12. 0x14041bed0 then loops over that count; negative values perform no inline scans.
findings.impact: The expected assertions are contradictory for counts-1/0/1 and leave diagnostic presence ambiguous for all non-clamped cases. A future harness must not turn this boilerplate into an incorrect oracle.
findings.requested_revision: Generate case-specific expected declared count, stored count, inline conversion count, and diagnostic presence. Require the clamp diagnostic only for13; require no clamp diagnostic for-1/0/1/12. Keep the existing correct handler-status and refresh expectations.

accepted_semantics.conclusion: Separate setup imports preserve same-dimension state; changed-dimension action is explicitly separate and recreates material20. Unique table/inline/list-node markers distinguish ordering and partial replacement, except the scalar-pair gap above. Dimension and mesh setup are qualified retained grammar, not new original-run evidence.

Nine headers precede payloads; failed header preserves target/later seeded tables, failed payload follows all resets. Widths4/6/7/6/7/6/9/6/3 and row marker shapes agree with static contract. Final-pair failure still reaches refresh; header/payload failure does not.

Initial record precedes every list clear. List order16f8/16e0/16c8/1710/1728 is preserved. Failed appended node remains linked/counted; later lists remain seeded. Ignored count EOF eventually clears remaining lists and can return0/refresh0.

Embedded flag1 skips two tables; node flag0 reads three. 41c070 differs from selector4 41b270. Constant transition retains physical arrays/counts; unknown-positive reuses old shape. Rank2 scratch EOF is not mislabeled as a committed dependent prefix.

Reviewed direct-scan handoff to fgets, one-LF skip, zero-count payload, completed positive payload discard, and EOF-stage cases agree with proposed lexical terminal positions. Stage byte ranges are input annotations, not independent runtime cursor observations. Runtime ftell/text translation remains unresolved.
Selector5 zeros before parsing and refreshes even on failure. Selector4 refreshes even on failure. Negative route stores modulo32 negation, selector=-1; later positive route retains negation field.

112 discovery and11 reserved actions are accurately labeled NOT_RUN; reserved policy explicitly requires a future freeze and does not claim independently validated held-out evidence. Shared generator/contract and shared scalar literals limit independence; no output-derived expectations were observed.

Uninitialized rank2 scratch on matching failure, malformed material ID, out-of-range counts, enabled864 scientific features, OOM/corrupt ownership, and arbitrary removal commands are properly excluded.
